repair: Remove StudyPart part1 because it duplicates the complete Study and does not identify a separable sample, data source, method, or state. Set part_id to null for sam2–sam5, iu2, sf2–sf4, td1, adm1–adm2, and f1–f10. Extend f1 with 533 eligible registrants and the author-reported response rate of 93.8% (500/533). Add an Interpretation linked to f7 that states the authors recommend that Singapore EQ-5D-3L users map their data to the EQ-5D-5L descriptive system and then apply the new Singapore EQ-5D-5L value set, especially for economic evaluation. Add a separate author-qualified novelty Interpretation: this is the first Singapore EQ-5D-5L value set and, to the authors’ knowledge, the first EQ-5D-5L value set estimated with between-dimension interaction terms.
